title: Prioritize unresolved incidents
description: Return exactly four columns: id, server_name, severity, age_hours. Include only unresolved incidents with critical or high severity. Sort critical before high; within one severity sort by age_hours DESC, then id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT id, server_name, severity, age_hours
FROM incidents
hints: An unresolved incident has resolved_at IS NULL.
Use CASE in ORDER BY for a custom severity order.
solution_explanation: CASE maps textual severity to an explicit sort priority.
